item.title: Building a Whole Project with a Code Agent
item.description: I used an AI code agent to take over and finish an entire group project, Standflow. This is the honest version: what the agent did, what I kept for myself, the guardrails that made it safe, the near-disaster, and what actually makes agentic development work.

item.title: Standflow: From an Overflowing Inbox to a Working System
item.description: The project case: a real customer with a real problem, the idea we proposed, and the system we sketched and then built to solve it. I was not on the company visit, so my part started from what the team brought back.
